$comment: Digest of the hunt manifests produced from the local hunt tables (ParadoxDirector/game-data), with the clock and random choice pinned (manifestDigest.js). Produced by the Director's resolver before the M1 move into shared/hunt-manifest on 14 October 2026; the Director and Metagame parity tests must reproduce it. It is a hash: it contains no game data. Regenerate only when the tables change on purpose.
algorithm: sha256 of BuildManifestDump lines joined by newline
